analysis.title: GS FINS & REITs Daily (November 3, 2026)
key_insights: US futures mixed pre-open (SPX -15bps, NDX +25bps, RTY -15bps) ahead of US midterm elections. Prediction markets imply a 90%+ chance Democrats win the House and a 65%+ chance they win the Senate.

US/Iran reportedly reviewing mediator proposals, while the US reportedly struck targets on Iran's Qeshm Island (NYT: a 'small-scale, defense measure' with 'no immediate plans to escalate'). WTI +2% at $98.50 after falling 8% the prior day.
AAPL -4% pre-market after EPS as investors focus on higher memory costs weighing on gross margins. PLTR -8% after guiding to a slowdown in bookings growth.

S&P Financial Index closed +1.76% last session, +7.1% above its 200DMA with a 14-day RSI of 65. 94% of S&P Financial stocks rose. Alts, Payments and Mortgage outperformed while Life Insurance, Large Cap Banks and E-Brokers lagged.

APO: management fees in line to slightly weaker (looks fee-rate driven), FRE beat on ~$36mn transaction fees with ~$15mn FRE beat from noncomp leverage. SRE ex-notables looks like a ~2-3% miss on assets and spread (~121bps, low end of 120-125bp range). Desk thinks SRE matters more and can see shares moving either way. Call focus: AI exposure (chip financing) and 2027 SRE outlook.

FISV: desk expects shares higher. Financial solutions returned to organic revenue growth in 3Q, core banking net attrition is improving, buybacks resume early ($500mn in 4Q), Project Elevate savings target doubled to $1bn, FY guide reiterated, and 4Q adjusted and organic revenue expected to return to growth. It was among the more shorted payments names. Desk flags a possible negative read-through to JKHY.
HLNE: FRE and management fees both light vs consensus, with the headline beat driven by other income and non-cash revenue.
UPST +5% pre-market: revenue and adjusted EBITDA well above consensus, offset by FY26 guidance cut below consensus.

PJT: 6% earnings beat falls to ~1-2% adjusted for a lower tax rate. Revenue missed ~1%, comp ratio in line, noncomp expenses 5% below consensus. Pipeline and 4Q-into-2027 activity commentary is the focus.

PAY: beat and raise. Gross revenue ~$372mn, 4% above consensus. Adjusted EBITDA $49.7mn vs $43.4mn consensus. 4Q26 revenue guide $373-378mn (~1% above consensus at midpoint). Lack of 2027 guidance could be a near-term overhang since the Street sits above the 4Q run rate.

ALLY vintage curves: 2024 outperformance holds, 2025 looks similar vs 2023, 2026 vintage shows higher delinquencies. The company says 2Q and 3Q 2026 vintages are tighter and it may take a couple more quarters of seasoning to see the curve bend.

MTB management meeting: NIM expected to stay in the mid-3.60s, loan growth to moderate in 4Q and 2027, fees targeted to the low 30s % of revenue from ~28%, ~90bps Basel 3 Endgame benefit, ~17% ROTCE into next year, and continued interest in depository M&A (prefers a large deal, would consider smaller banks).

Brokers and crypto: after the Binance cybersecurity incident, GS analysts see possible flight to safety toward COIN, BTGO and HOOD. They also flag possible lower institutional crypto adoption, a higher bar for future crypto regulation, and tougher US licensing for international exchanges.

Prime update: global Fundamental L/S returned -3.49% in October (beta losses and negative alpha), +9.1% YTD. Global equities saw the largest dollar net selling since March, split evenly between long and short sales.

REITs: SBAC 3Q26 AFFO $3.17 beat consensus by 6c, EBITDA $488mn vs $489mn consensus, FY26 outlook lowered on FX and the Chile/Ecuador asset sale. UDR new lease rate growth -1.2% vs consensus -0.6%. JAN AFFO 25c, 1c above consensus, with 2026 AFFO guidance raised to 98c. VNO Core FFO 65c, 2c above consensus, NY leasing spreads +37.2% GAAP.
Housing Market Activity Scale for the week of Oct 25 was flat sequentially, down 11% y/y and 33% below the long-term average. The 30-year mortgage rate fell 8bps to 7.24%.

GIR midterm preview: Democrats are seen taking the House with ~236 seats, and the Senate is less certain and less important. Spending authority expires Dec 11 and the debt limit is likely reached in Q1 2027. GIR expects new post-election tariff increases to more than offset selective rollbacks, lifting the effective tariff rate by a little under 2pp.

GIR Global Markets Comment: the peak of the last hiking cycle (5.3%) may anchor long-dated forward rates. Forward yields above 5% look less plausible if the funds rate peaks near 4-4.25% (GIR modal) or a hike or two beyond. The Fed-policy and deficit/AI-financing explanations for higher real rates are seen as less conflicting than portrayed.

earnings_insights: APO (reported 11/3 pre-market): management fees in line to slightly below consensus, FRE beat consensus by ~$15mn on ~$36mn transaction fees, SRE ex-notables ~2-3% below consensus at ~121bps spread. Fee paying AUM ~$53bn, GIR ~$42bn.

FISV (reported 11/3): Financial solutions back to organic revenue growth in 3Q, $500mn buyback planned for 4Q, Project Elevate savings target raised to $1bn, FY guide reiterated, total reported Clover revenue expected to return to double digit growth in 4Q.
HLNE (reported 11/3): FRE and management fees below consensus, headline beat from other income and non-cash revenue.
UPST (reported 11/2 post-close): revenue and adjusted EBITDA well above consensus, FY26 guidance cut below consensus.
PJT (reported 11/3): earnings beat of 6% reported, ~1-2% adjusted for a lower tax rate. Revenue ~1% below consensus. Noncomp expenses 5% below consensus.

PAY (reported 11/2 post-close): gross revenue ~$372mn, 4% above consensus. Adjusted EBITDA $49.7mn reported vs $43.4mn consensus. 4Q26 guidance: revenue $373-378mn (~1% above consensus at midpoint), contribution profit $120-122mn (+1% vs consensus at midpoint), adjusted EBITDA $45-50mn vs ~$47mn consensus.

SBAC (reported 3Q26): AFFO $3.17 reported, 6c above consensus. EBITDA $488mn reported vs $489mn consensus. FY26 outlook lowered on tower cash flow and EBITDA from FX and Chile/Ecuador sale, $800mn buyback authorization remaining.

UDR (preliminary results 10/21, call 11/3 at 12pm): Core FFO 65c, 2% above consensus. Blended lease rate growth 1.7% including JV (2.0% excluding) vs consensus 2.0%. New lease rate growth -1.2% excluding JV vs consensus -0.6%. Repurchased ~$185mn of stock since end of July vs GSe $50mn for 2H26.
JAN (reported 3Q26): AFFO 25c reported, 1c above consensus. Acquisitions $1.75bn vs $1bn consensus. 2026 AFFO guidance 98c, +2c at midpoint. SS occupancy 89.7%, 70bps above expectations.
VNO (reported 3Q26): Core FFO 65c reported, 2c above consensus. NY leasing 526k sq ft, spreads +37.2% GAAP and +25.9% cash. NY leased office occupancy 93%.
AAPL (reported, pre-market reaction 11/3): shares -4% as investors focus on higher memory costs weighing on gross margins. PLTR (reported): shares -8% on guided slowdown in bookings growth.
Earnings still to come: ETN, SHOP pre-market 11/3, and AMD, ANET, BKNG, SMCI post-close 11/3.

crypto_views: Bitcoin -1% at $76.8k on the prior session.
